sources.locator: pp25-27, especially p26 Figure 6; consumer assumption is not manufacturer equivalence

requirements.description: Record exact modem variant and conditional reference applicability; retain unresolved manufacturer equivalence. The underlying part's RF contract remains independently required.

Review actual selected bypass/reservoir parts, effective capacitance under bias/temperature/tolerance, ESR and actual supply/load envelope. A nominal 100 uF ceramic does not establish 100 uF effective reservoir.
Review actual peak/RMS current, minimum copper and via plating, neckdowns, current sharing and voltage drop. No capacity is inferred from zone settings or a nominal converter rating.

Review direct local VBAT feeds, all three load contacts and ground returns, filled distribution, pad neckdowns, copper thickness, via plating/current sharing, voltage drop, optional filtering and surge protection. Zone settings and DRC alone are insufficient.
Model the actual regulator/battery/harness, modem bursts and startup, reservoir/ESR, low-battery operation and any battery-fed USB-detect margin.

Measure VBAT and detection voltage during worst operating conditions, converter stability and temperatures, startup/shutdown and prototype functionality. No current or safety rating is inferred from routed geometry.
